'''December 1999 Melbourne tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 19 December 1999. Michael won it. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d154">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-23-tr-melbourne-19-12-99d154/ tr-melbourne-19-12-99], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 23 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-23-tr-melbourne-19-12-99d154/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 December 1999
* '''Site:''' Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' Michael
